I can't give you an amount for creatine, or any supplement. What I can say is that creatine is one of the most studied supplements out there, and people use it in all phases of training, cutting included. It works by helping your muscles with short, hard efforts, so it isn't tied to whether you're in a deficit. For what's right for you, a doctor or dietitian is the one to ask, especially if you take any medication or have a health condition.

If you want, I can look at how your lifts are holding up during the cut.
